name: Chalet Zur Rose
beschreibung:
Chalet Zur Rose is situated in the picturesque mountain village of Berwang at an altitude of over 1,300 metres. Guests treasure its welcoming atmosphere, personal care, and peaceful location overlooking the Zugspitz peaks.

In winter, ski lifts and cross-country tracks are just a stone's throw away, while summer brings refreshing mountain air, blooming pastures, and abundant hiking trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Chalet Zur Rose in Berwang provides charming alpine accommodation in the highest village of the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena.
